description: Source code for an interruptible conversational bot demonstrating Krisp VIVA noise filtering, turn detection, VAD, and integration with Deepgram STT/TTS and OpenAI LLM, using Pipecat framework.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates the pipeline and its parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the pipeline execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline, including signal handling.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with shared context.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for user turn handling.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to stop user turns based on KrispVivaTurn analysis.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, compatible with Pipecat Cloud.
